metadata.archetype_justification: Application has Oracle database connections via JDBC with write operations (INSERT INTO loan_applications), and exposes a form-based web interface for CRUD operations on loan entities. Classified as stateful-crud.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 1.15 yields Not Ready band but 11 High findings (in 2-11 range) force Remediation Required tier. The pervasive immaturity across all categories drives the extremely low score while the High count falls just below the >=12 threshold.

top_gaps.impact: No automated testing, no deployment safety nets, slow delivery cycle

findings.title: Managed Compute
findings.description: All compute runs on Oracle WebLogic Server 10.3 on Solaris 10. No managed container orchestration (ECS/EKS), serverless (Lambda), or Fargate usage detected.
findings.gap: No managed compute services in use. Entire workload runs on a self-managed application server on an EOL operating system.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to managed compute — containerize with ECS/Fargate after framework upgrade, or rebuild as Lambda functions for individual endpoints.

findings.title: Managed Databases
findings.description: Database is self-managed Oracle 11g accessed via raw JDBC. Connection string indicates a bare-metal or VM-hosted Oracle instance. No managed database service detected.
findings.gap: Self-managed database with no automated backups, failover, scaling, or patching. Oracle 11g is past EOL.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL or Aurora PostgreSQL. Use AWS DMS for data migration.

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure detected. The application uses only synchronous HTTP request/response via Struts action mappings.
findings.gap: No messaging infrastructure for cross-service state propagation. Tight synchronous coupling.
findings.recommendation: Introduce EventBridge or SNS for loan application lifecycle events (created, approved, rejected).

findings.title: Network Security
findings.description: No VPC, subnet, security group, or network segmentation configuration found. Deployment on Solaris 10 with no AWS networking.
findings.gap: No network security controls. No evidence of firewall rules or access control between tiers.
findings.recommendation: Deploy in a VPC with private subnets for application and database tiers. Implement security groups with least-privilege rules.

findings.title: API Entry Point
findings.description: No API Gateway, ALB, CloudFront, or any managed entry point detected. Application directly exposed via WebLogic Server HTTP listener.
findings.gap: Direct service exposure with no gateway or load balancer. No throttling, auth, or request validation at the network edge.
findings.recommendation: Place API Gateway or ALB in front of the application with throttling, request validation, and WAF rules.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling
findings.description: No auto-scaling configuration found. Application runs on single WebLogic Server instance with static capacity.
findings.gap: All capacity statically provisioned. Cannot respond to traffic spikes or scale down during low demand.
findings.recommendation: Configure auto-scaling after migration to managed compute.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery
findings.description: No automated backup configuration found. No AWS Backup plans, RDS backup retention, or any backup mechanism detected.
findings.gap: No automated backups. A data loss event could be unrecoverable.
findings.recommendation: After database migration to RDS/Aurora, enable automated backups with 7+ day retention and PITR.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage
findings.description: No infrastructure-as-code exists. No Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Helm, or any IaC tool detected. All infrastructure manually provisioned.
findings.gap: 0% IaC coverage — all infrastructure created manually (ClickOps).
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in CDK or Terraform. Start with core resources: VPC, compute (ECS/EKS), database (RDS), and CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation
findings.description: No CI/CD automation exists. No GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CodeBuild, CodePipeline, or any pipeline definition detected. Manual WAR upload deployment.
findings.gap: No automated build, test, or deploy pipeline. All deployments are manual and lack quality gates.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with AWS CodePipeline and CodeBuild. Minimum stages: build → unit test → integration test → deploy to staging → deploy to production.

findings.title: Programming Languages
findings.description: Java 5 with Apache Struts 1.3 framework. All EOL since 2009-2013. No AWS SDK. Compound legacy across language, framework, and SDK.
findings.gap: Language (Java 5), framework (Struts 1.3), and runtime (WebLogic 10.3) all past EOL with no cloud-native tooling support.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to Java 17+ with Spring Boot 3.x and AWS SDK v2.

findings.title: Monolith vs Microservices
findings.description: Tightly-coupled monolith with no module boundaries. Single Action class handles HTTP, business logic, and database access.
findings.gap: No module boundaries, no architectural layers, pervasive coupling between presentation, business, and data access layers.
findings.recommendation: Establish proper architectural layering (controller → service → repository). See Decomposition Strategy for approach options.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP via Struts action mappings. No message publishing, no event emission, no async patterns.
findings.gap: 100% synchronous with no async capability. Loan lifecycle events not published for downstream consumers.
findings.recommendation: Implement event publishing for loan lifecycle state changes using EventBridge or SNS after technology migration.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling
findings.description: All operations handled synchronously within the HTTP request/response cycle. No async job infrastructure for batch or long-running operations.
findings.gap: No async job infrastructure. Batch operations would block HTTP connections with no status polling mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing for batch operations using SQS + Lambda or Step Functions after migration.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy
findings.description: No API versioning strategy detected. Struts action mapping defines /loan with no version prefix.
findings.gap: No versioning — any API changes break all consumers simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Implement URL-path versioning (e.g., /v1/loans) with a documented backward-compatibility policy after technology migration.

findings.title: Service Discovery
findings.description: Database endpoint hardcoded in source code (jdbc:oracle:thin:@dbprod01:1521:LOANDB). No service registry, API catalog, or dynamic discovery.
findings.gap: All service endpoints hardcoded. No dynamic discovery, no environment-specific configuration.
findings.recommendation: Externalize configuration to environment variables or AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Use service discovery after migration.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage
findings.description: No object storage (S3) or managed unstructured data storage detected. No document storage or parsing capabilities.
findings.gap: No managed storage for unstructured data. Loan documents likely on local file systems or Oracle BLOB columns.
findings.recommendation: Store loan documents in S3 with lifecycle policies. Implement Textract for automated document parsing.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer
findings.description: Database access directly in Struts Action class via raw JDBC. No repository pattern, no DAO layer, no ORM.
findings.gap: No data access layer. Database concerns mixed with presentation and business logic.
findings.recommendation: Implement a repository/DAO pattern with service layer separation. Use Spring Data JPA after framework migration.

findings.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
findings.description: Oracle 11g database identified. Oracle 11g reached end-of-life in December 2020. Extended support ended. No version pinning in IaC (no IaC exists).
findings.gap: Database engine past EOL. No security patches available. Running unsupported software creates compliance and security risk.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to Aurora PostgreSQL (current, fully managed, auto-patching) or RDS PostgreSQL. Use AWS DMS for zero-downtime migration.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest configured. Oracle 11g database has no KMS or TDE configuration. Loan application data (PII) stored unencrypted.
findings.gap: Loan application data (PII — applicant names, financial information) stored without encryption at rest.
findings.recommendation: After database migration to RDS/Aurora, enable encryption at rest with customer-managed KMS keys.

findings.title: API Authentication
findings.description: No API authentication detected. No authentication filters, security constraints, OAuth2, JWT, or API keys. Endpoints appear open.
findings.gap: No authentication on API endpoints. Any network-accessible client can submit loan applications without proving identity.
findings.recommendation: Implement authentication using Amazon Cognito or API Gateway authorizer with JWT validation.

findings.title: Centralized Identity Integration
findings.description: No identity provider integration detected. No Cognito, OIDC, SAML, SSO, or centralized authentication configuration.
findings.gap: No authentication system exists. When implemented, must integrate with centralized IdP.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito as centralized IdP with OIDC/SAML federation support.

findings.title: Secrets Management
findings.description: Plaintext database credentials hardcoded in source code: DB_URL, DB_USER='loan_app', DB_PASS='loanApp2010'. Committed to version control.
findings.gap: Critical security vulnerability. Production database credentials plaintext in source code, exposed in git history.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate exposed credentials. Store all secrets in AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching
findings.description: No patching strategy or vulnerability scanning. Deployment on Solaris 10 (EOL) with WebLogic 10.3 (EOL), Java 5 (EOL). All unpatched.
findings.gap: All compute software is EOL and unpatched. No vulnerability scanning or patching automation.
findings.recommendation: After migration to managed compute, use AWS-optimized base images (Corretto, Bottlerocket). Enable Amazon Inspector.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline
findings.description: No security scanning tools configured. No SAST, dependency scanning, or container scanning. SQL injection vulnerability exists undetected.
findings.gap: No security scanning. Known vulnerabilities (SQL injection) exist undetected. No pipeline to integrate scanning into.
findings.recommendation: After CI/CD is established, integrate SAST (CodeGuru/Semgrep), dependency scanning, and container scanning with blocking gates.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing
findings.description: No distributed tracing instrumented. No X-Ray SDK, OpenTelemetry, or trace ID propagation.
findings.gap: No tracing capability. Cannot trace requests, identify bottlenecks, or correlate failures.
findings.recommendation: After migration, instrument with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry. Spring Boot 3.x has built-in Micrometer Tracing support.

findings.title: SLO Definitions
findings.description: No SLO definitions found. No CloudWatch alarms, latency thresholds, error rate targets, or availability targets.
findings.gap: No formal SLOs. Cannot measure whether system meets user expectations.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for critical user journeys: loan quote latency (p99 < 500ms), submission success rate (> 99.5%), availability (> 99.9%).

findings.title: Business Metrics
findings.description: No custom metrics published. No CloudWatch PutMetricData, no business event tracking, no dashboards.
findings.gap: No business metrics. Cannot track loan volume, approval rates, or conversion rates.
findings.recommendation: Publish business metrics via CloudWatch: loans_submitted, loans_approved, average_loan_amount, conversion_rate.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, anomaly detection, or incident management integration.
findings.gap: No alerting on error rates, latency, or operational metrics. Issues discovered only via user reports.
findings.recommendation: Configure CloudWatch alarms on error rate, p99 latency, and 5xx responses. Enable anomaly detection on key metrics.

findings.title: Integration Testing
findings.description: No automated tests of any kind exist. No unit tests, integration tests, contract tests, or test framework dependencies.
findings.gap: Zero automated test coverage. Regression risk during modernization is extremely high.
findings.recommendation: Establish test infrastructure: JUnit 5 for unit tests, Testcontainers for integration tests, API contract tests for the loan endpoint.

findings.title: Incident Response Automation
findings.description: No runbooks or incident response automation found. No SSM Automation, Lambda remediation, or incident workflow definitions.
findings.gap: No incident response documentation or automation. Response to failures is entirely ad hoc.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common failure scenarios. Implement SSM Automation for automated remediation after migration.

findings.title: Observability Ownership
findings.description: No observability ownership defined. No CODEOWNERS, no dashboards, no alarm owners, no team attribution.
findings.gap: No observability ownership. No team accountable for service health monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Define service ownership in CODEOWNERS. Create per-service dashboards with team attribution.

findings.title: Resource Tagging Governance
findings.description: No resource tagging found. No IaC to tag resources. No tagging standard or enforcement.
findings.gap: No tagging governance. Cannot track costs, identify ownership, or enforce environment identification.
findings.recommendation: After IaC adoption, implement mandatory tags: Environment, Service, Owner, CostCenter. Enforce with AWS Config.

evaluations.title: Workflow Orchestration
evaluations.reason: stateful-crud service with simple CRUD operations (calculate loan, save application) — no multi-step workflow coordination exists or is needed.

evaluations.title: High Availability and Fault Isolation
evaluations.reason: has_deployed_workload=false — no IaC or deployment manifests define compute. HA cannot be assessed from source code alone.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: has_iac_provisioning_aws_resources=false — application source-code-only repo. CloudTrail is an account-level concern belonging to foundation infrastructure.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — no stored procedures, triggers, or proprietary SQL. All business logic in Java application layer. SQL is standard INSERT.

evaluations.title: Deployment Strategy
evaluations.reason: has_deployed_workload=false — no Dockerfile, no IaC defining compute, no deployment configuration. Deployment orchestration managed externally.

detail.current_state: Tightly-coupled Struts 1.3 monolith on WebLogic/Solaris. Single Action class handles all logic.

pathways.name: Move to Containers

detail.current_state: WebLogic Server 10.3 on Solaris 10 — manual WAR deployment. No Dockerfiles or container orchestration.
detail.approach: Refactor-then-containerize — requires framework migration (Struts 1.3 → Spring Boot) and Java upgrade first.

pathways.name: Move to Open Source

pathways.name: Move to Managed Analytics

pathways.name: Move to Modern DevOps
